I bet you think this is a joke...

There are THOUSANDS of men spending more on OnlyFans models than rent, bills & food because they can't risk "losing her"

That one sentence is the whole AI OFM play

Build the girl
Create the attachment
Charge for access

The £7 coffee complaint is funny because the £686 OF line is the customer profile... this guy is screaming about a coffee because that feels like a scam he can say out loud, then he's quietly sending hundreds to a girl in his phone because admitting that one means admitting he's lonely, cooked & being rinsed by his own need for attention

Public budget = coffee, rent, food, bills

Private budget = porn, gambling, girls, drugs, weird little emotional holes he doesn't tell anyone about

Public budget gets audited by his brain. Private budget gets justified by his emotions. That's the whole fucking business & if you don't understand that, you should probably stop reading now because you'll be one of the retards making $2k/mo wondering why the "AI girl thing" isn't working for you

You're not selling porn

Porn is free. Twitter is full of it, Reddit is full of it, Telegram is disgusting, PornHub exists, every man alive can see a naked woman in 3 seconds without paying you a cent

You're selling the feeling that a hot girl picked him out of everyone else & might disappear if he stops paying

That's why he argues over £7 coffee then sends £686 to OF without blinking

The coffee doesn't make him feel wanted

She does

Or at least he thinks she does

Now build the same thing with AI & stop overcomplicating it like some 140 IQ autist trying to make a "consumer app"

One girl. One character. One belief system

Do NOT make 6 plastic AI sluts because you're bored. Most operators do this & stay broke because none of the girls feel real enough to matter. They build folders, not people. Then they wonder why no one gives a fuck about their "portfolio" of fake girls that all look like they were born in the same Midjourney lab

You build ONE girl so believable that a man can lie to himself without much effort

Face first

Generate through NanoBanana2 or ChatGPT Image2 on WaveSpeed

20+ generations per scene

Reject ~80%

Kill anything with a masculine jaw, perfect symmetry, plastic skin, dead eyes, teeth too white, hair floating like a wig, face drift between angles... all that fake glossy AI slop that makes normal men bounce in 2 seconds because their brain clocks "computer" before their dick clocks "girl"

Keep the ones with a soft feminine face, small imperfections, real skin texture, slightly uneven features, eyes with moisture, same room, same mirror, same "she actually lives here" feeling

He isn't subscribing to "AI"

He's subscribing to the lie that this girl exists somewhere & could like him if he plays it right

Your job is to make that lie easy to believe

Video next

SeedDance 2 or Kling Motion Control through WaveSpeed. Feed it reference motion from REAL girls, not random AI movement. Pull reels from actual OF creators... hair adjustment, mirror turn, lip bite, camera lean, all the tiny movements real girls do without thinking because they have a nervous system & aren't a fucking mannequin trying to escape a dream

Map those motions onto your girl

Random AI motion = haunted mannequin

Real reference motion = human enough to pass

Then ruin the quality on purpose because this is where the nerds get everything wrong

AI output is too clean. Real phone footage is messy. The content that converts looks like some girl filmed it badly on her iPhone at 1am, not like a VC demo from an AI startup run by men who haven't touched a woman since covid

Pipeline:

Generation ---> CapCut (white balance + saturation) ---> DaVinci Resolve (grain + JPEG damage) ---> Instagram edits app (native IG metadata)

You want compression, low light, tiny imperfections, slightly off framing, that stupid "I just recorded this in my bedroom" energy

Perfect output screams AI

Human output has damage

Now traffic

IG = discovery
X = brand + safety net
Telegram = audience you actually own

If you only build on IG you're a fucking retard renting your entire income from Meta. Meta bans you, you're dead. I lost IG accounts & still hit record months because X + Telegram were already alive. New IG gets created, X/Telegram audience feeds it, revenue keeps moving while everyone else is in group chats crying about appeals

Build the backup BEFORE the ban

Now the money part, where most of you will still fuck it up because you think the sub fee matters

Base sub = $9.99/mo

This is NOT the business. This is the door fee. This is the "come inside" price. The real money is PPV messages

PPV = locked DM content they pay to open

My real last-month breakdown on one girl:

New subs = $7,030
PPV messages = $42,189
PPV posts = $2,841
Tips = $5,339
Renewals = $3,103

Net profit = $60,504

PPV messages = ~70% of revenue

Read that again until your little guru brain stops thinking followers are the business. The money is not the sub. The money is not likes. The money is not the public content. The money is the DM

You get him in at $9.99

Then you qualify him with the first PPV

First PPV = $80-111

Safe content first. Lingerie, suggestive, nothing insane. If he pays, he's telling you he has emotional budget. Then you escalate:

$111 ---> $200 ---> $300 ---> $400

Each one feels more personal, more private, more "only for you"

You're not selling files

You're selling deeper access to the story in his head

And the story is:

"She likes me more than the other guys"

That story is worth more than rent to some men

This is why the chatter matters more than the face. A chatter is the person typing as the AI girl. You can chat yourself at first, which you should, because if you don't understand the psychology you'll hire some agency & let them burn your best whales like idiots while you sit there staring at your dashboard wondering why the revenue isn't moving

Most chatters are glorified cashiers

They get a new sub & within 3 messages they're trying to sell a $300 set

Dead

He knows he's being farmed

Good opener:

"heyyy"

Then:

"I noticed you subscribed & I just want to say thank you... most guys just look & leave so the fact that you stayed means a lot to me"

Soft. Low pressure. No desperation. Makes him feel like subscribing was a decision she noticed instead of a transaction you were waiting to monetize

First 5 messages decide if he's a $9.99 sub or a £686 bank statement screenshot waiting to happen

Message 1 = soft open
Message 2 = thanks for staying
Message 3 = ask something simple
Message 4 = respond like you actually read it
Message 5 = make him feel slightly different from other men

Then wait

Do not sell instantly. Retards sell instantly. Operators build the emotional hook first because most of these men have nobody asking them anything without wanting something obvious in return. If your chatter can make him feel listened to for 10 minutes, he's already half-sold

Then you use hot & cold

Talk daily for a few days

Disappear

He panics. Tips come in. Messages come in. "Did I do something wrong?" comes in. His whole nervous system starts negotiating with a fake girl because she stopped replying for 48 hours

Come back with:

"sorry I was thinking about something you said last week & it distracted me all day..."

Now the silence wasn't neglect

It was proof she cared

His brain melts

This is why men spend more on OF than rent

Rent gives shelter

She gives narrative

He can replace an apartment

He can't risk "losing her"

That's the lever

You're not trying to make him horny. Horny is cheap. Any idiot can make a man horny. You're trying to make him feel selected, and selection is expensive because most men walk around feeling invisible 24/7

Operator stack from zero:

$300-500/mo per character
WaveSpeed API credits
Used iPhone 12 + new SIM + data plan
One model
One Fanvue
One X
One Telegram
One IG
Chat yourself for 1-3 months
Hire Romania / Serbia / Philippines later at $150 base + commission
Or use an agency at 20% if you're lazy

Month 1-2 = build the girl, post quality content, chat yourself, learn what men say when they think a hot girl is listening. Revenue $0-2k. This is where the weak ones quit because they thought AI porn was a vending machine

Month 3-4 = first reel hits, ~100 subs, first PPV ladder working. Revenue $3-8k

Month 5-6 = ~500 subs, chatter or agency takes over, you focus on content + distribution. Revenue $10-25k

Month 7-12 = same girl across multiple accounts, IG for traffic, X for brand, Telegram for retention. Revenue per good character = $30-70k+

Add the second girl only after the first is maxed

The Costa screenshot is funny because everyone is laughing at the hypocrisy

Wrong lens

It's a demand signal

A man complaining about £7 coffee while spending £686 on OF is not "stupid"

He's showing you exactly where logic ends & emotional spending starts

Build where logic ends

That's where the $$$ is

Twin brothers from Missouri answered the call to serve in the U.S. Army and deployed to fight for America during World War II, but only one would return home. Thomas pictured on the right. 

While leading an attack on an enemy-held hill on Negros Island in the Philippines, Private Davis was struck by enemy rifle fire and made the ultimate sacrifice in service to our nation. 

He became one of the brave 1.9 million Americans awarded the Purple Heart, a lasting symbol of courage, sacrifice, and devotion to country.

data.raw_text:
🔥 Ring Of Fire Weekly Update 🔥
Sunday, May 24, 2026

Our weekly check on the Ring of Fire shows strong activity across the Pacific arc. The largest event was a M6.6 along the southern East Pacific Rise, followed by a M6.0 near Hawaii. Additional major quakes include M5.9 events in Indonesia and Japan, and a M5.8 along the Peru margin.

Multiple M5.7 to M5.6 earthquakes were recorded across Papua New Guinea, Vanuatu, Tonga, and Alaska, with continued activity through the Solomon Islands, the Philippines, and along the South Pacific island chains.

Activity remains concentrated along the main Pacific plate boundary from Alaska through Japan and Southeast Asia, continuing into the South Pacific and along the west coast of the Americas.

Above the Norm News

#EarthquakeWatch #RingOfFire #SeismicActivity #EarthUpdates #GeoMonitoring
